title: Evening Table
description: A pillar candle glows in a pink pot beside a tall blue bottle, a green vase, and a small white creamer. Flat planes of color and shadows in lilac and teal give the arrangement a quiet, late-evening warmth.
alt: Evening Table: a candle in a pink pot beside a tall blue bottle, a green vase, and a white creamer on a white table

title: Current
description: Bands of teal, grey, and blue ripple across the canvas, and a striped figure surfaces from the pattern. It reads as a swimmer, a bird, or a current, depending on how long you look.
alt: Current: rippling bands of teal, grey, and blue with a striped figure surfacing from the pattern

title: Lilac Street
description: Lilac buildings with deep violet windows line a street that runs toward a flight of steps. Yellow cylinders, orange cones, and spheres stand on the green like players on a stage.
alt: Lilac Street: lilac buildings with deep violet windows line a street that runs toward a flight of steps

title: Blue Hair
description: A woman with long blue-green hair and a green flower behind her ear looks out from a violet ground. Clean outlines and flat color give the portrait a calm, graphic strength.
alt: Blue Hair: a woman with long blue-green hair and a green flower behind her ear looks out from a violet ground

title: Pear and Red Bowl
description: A green-and-red pear leans toward a tall cream vessel, a terracotta pot, and a deep red bowl on a purple cloth. Sharp edges and saturated shapes turn kitchen objects into something monumental.
alt: Pear and Red Bowl: a green and red pear, a tall cream vessel, a terracotta pot, and a deep red bowl on a purple cloth

title: Quilt Star
description: An eight-pointed star radiates through rings of lime, scarlet, and plum. The hard-edged symmetry borrows from quilt blocks and stained glass, held in tension by clashing complementary colors.
alt: Quilt Star: an eight-pointed star in rings of lime, scarlet, and plum

title: Moon and Tear
description: A full moon hangs over a violet sea while a blue figure sits on the shore, looking out. At the edge of the picture a pale face sheds a single tear.
alt: Moon and Tear: a full moon hangs over a violet sea while a blue figure sits on the shore, looking out

title: Hookah
description: A hookah with a faceted glass stem, a red base, and a coiled hose stands on a dark table. Behind it the wall fades from pale cream to deep ochre.
alt: Hookah: a hookah with a faceted glass stem, a red base, and a coiled hose stands on a dark table

title: Blue Lily
description: A single lily in translucent washes of turquoise and blue, its stamens drawn in deep violet, on a pale lavender ground. The layered washes let the paper glow through the petals.
alt: Blue Lily: a turquoise lily in translucent watercolor on a pale lavender ground

title: Violet Skyline
description: A row of violet towers stands against a yellow sky and repeats, upside down, in the water below. Flat bands of purple, yellow, and blue turn a city into pure pattern.
alt: Violet Skyline: a row of violet towers stands against a yellow sky and repeats, upside down, in the water below

title: Waves of Color
description: Wavy blocks of red, yellow, blue, orange, and green fit together like pieces of a puzzle. Darker veils laid over the top add a second, slower rhythm.
alt: Waves of Color: wavy blocks of red, yellow, blue, orange, and green fit together like pieces of a puzzle

title: Panda and Friends
description: A toy panda, a white chef figure, a doll's head, and a ruffled blue flower crowd together on a green table. A warm orange wall makes the blues and whites stand out.
alt: Panda and Friends: a toy panda, a white chef figure, a doll's head, and a ruffled blue flower crowd together on a green table

title: Clown on a Swing
description: A clown doll in a polka-dot suit sits on a swing, half white and half black, with a red nose and a frilled collar. The warm grey wash behind it keeps all attention on the costume.
alt: Clown on a Swing: a clown doll in a polka-dot suit sits on a swing, half white and half black, with a red nose and a frilled collar

title: Pitcher and Bottle
description: A small pitcher balanced on a rounded jar stands beside a tall bottle, drawn in deep blacks and soft greys. Their shadows stretch across a pale tabletop.
alt: Pitcher and Bottle: a small pitcher balanced on a rounded jar stands beside a tall bottle, drawn in deep blacks and soft greys

title: Blue Hills
description: Layered hills in teal, violet, and dusty pink stack toward a bare linen sky. A landscape reduced to overlapping waves of cool color.
alt: Blue Hills: layered hills in teal, violet, and pink beneath a bare linen sky

title: Clouds over the Valley
description: Cumulus clouds drift across a deep blue sky above rolling green hills and a line of trees. The clouds are painted thickly, so the sky feels heavier and closer than the land beneath it.
alt: Clouds over the Valley: thick white clouds in a deep blue sky above green hills

title: Nine Prints
description: Nine small prints arranged in a grid: sunbursts, striped hills, and a wide-eyed creature, alone and then layered over one another. Blues and violets shift from square to square as the images combine.
alt: Nine Prints: nine small prints arranged in a grid: sunbursts, striped hills, and a wide-eyed creature, alone and then layered over one another

title: Eggs on a Cloth
description: Six eggs in blue, violet, and red rest in the hollows of a white cloth under a washed blue sky. Each one sits on its own small pool of colored shadow.
alt: Eggs on a Cloth: six eggs in blue, violet, and red rest in the hollows of a white cloth under a washed blue sky

title: Arches
description: Orange and blue arches loop over a violet ground, overlapping into unexpected greens and browns where they cross. A playful, rhythmic composition, like a bassline made visible.
alt: Arches: orange and blue arches looping over a violet ground

title: Overlapping Vessels
description: Bottles, jars, and a tall vase overlap in purple, crimson, and teal, each shape showing through the next. Where two forms cross, a third color appears.
alt: Overlapping Vessels: bottles, jars, and a tall vase overlap in purple, crimson, and teal, each shape showing through the next

title: Banana and Apple
description: A banana and a red apple sit in a glass bowl on a round, sunlit table. The stormy grey wall behind makes the yellow glow.
alt: Banana and Apple: a banana and a red apple sit in a glass bowl on a round, sunlit table

title: Skyline at Dusk
description: A skyline in silhouette against a sky fading from clear blue to burning orange. The gradient washes do the storytelling; the buildings are only shadows.
alt: Skyline at Dusk: a silhouetted city skyline against a sky fading from blue to orange

title: Mask and Clown
description: A golden mask draped with beads sits on a turned wooden stand, with a small clown doll leaning at its foot. Blue on one side and pink on the other frame the pair.
alt: Mask and Clown: a golden mask draped with beads sits on a turned wooden stand, with a small clown doll leaning at its foot

title: Color Windows
description: Soft washes of green, blue, rose, violet, and gold fill a grid of panes divided by white lines. Curved shapes run across the panes like a view through a window.
alt: Color Windows: soft washes of green, blue, rose, violet, and gold fill a grid of panes divided by white lines

title: Wine, Bag, and Shoe
description: A wine bottle, a glass, a black handbag, and a violet high-heeled shoe are arranged on a white cloth. The folds behind them are washed in pale green and blue.
alt: Wine, Bag, and Shoe: a wine bottle, a glass, a black handbag, and a violet high-heeled shoe are arranged on a white cloth

title: Two Tulips
description: Two tulips, one crimson and one blush pink, rise from a terracotta pot on a dark table. Loose, delicate washes keep the flowers light while the shadow anchors them.
alt: Two Tulips: a crimson and a blush-pink tulip in a terracotta pot on a dark table

title: Pattern Study
description: A pencil drawing packed with pattern: checkerboards bending into the distance, scales, stripes, zigzags, and rings. Shading alone separates one plane from the next.
alt: Pattern Study: a pencil drawing packed with pattern: checkerboards bending into the distance, scales, stripes, zigzags, and rings

title: Dark Vessel
description: A single tall vessel with two small handles, its dark mouth open to the viewer, drawn in soft black on a rough ground. Light catches the rim and the bands around its base.
alt: Dark Vessel: a single tall vessel with two small handles, its dark mouth open to the viewer, drawn in soft black on a rough ground

title: Coffee Pot
description: A tall coffee pot with a long spout and a looping handle, painted in transparent grey washes. A small ball and a dark tray anchor it to the table.
alt: Coffee Pot: a tall coffee pot with a long spout and a looping handle, painted in transparent grey washes

title: Pattern in Grey
description: The patterns of the pencil study return in paint: checkerboards, scales, stripes, and rings in cool greys and whites. Without color, the composition depends on rhythm and tone.
alt: Pattern in Grey: the patterns of the pencil study return in paint: checkerboards, scales, stripes, and rings in cool greys and whites

title: Study in Grey
description: A sphere, a cube, a glass jar, and two dark cups under one light source, painted in warm greys. A value study that strips color away to show how light alone builds form.
alt: Study in Grey: a sphere, a cube, a glass jar, and two dark cups painted in warm greys

title: Melon and Orange
description: A green melon cut open and a bright orange sit behind a long blue-and-yellow shape lying across a grey tabletop. Loose, wet washes keep the fruit fresh and luminous.
alt: Melon and Orange: a green melon cut open and a bright orange sit behind a long blue-and-yellow shape lying across a grey tabletop

title: Blue Jug and Striped Pot
description: A tall blue jug, a striped round pot, a drinking glass, and an egg in its cup, painted in thin washes of violet and aqua. The white cloth beneath them is drawn with only a few grey folds.
alt: Blue Jug and Striped Pot: a tall blue jug, a striped round pot, a drinking glass, and an egg in its cup, painted in thin washes of violet and aqua

title: Pale Eggs
description: Five pale eggs settle into a white cloth beneath a grey-violet sky. The color is held back almost to nothing, so the cast shadows do the work.
alt: Pale Eggs: five pale eggs settle into a white cloth beneath a grey-violet sky

title: White Drapery
description: A white cloth rises into peaks and falls into deep folds, modelled in soft greys against a sandy ground. A study of how fabric holds light and shadow.
alt: White Drapery: a white cloth rises into peaks and falls into deep folds, modelled in soft greys against a sandy ground

title: Empty Room
description: An empty interior drawn in soft black: tall windows, a round column, and a doorway opening to the outside. Smudged shadows give the room its depth and quiet.
alt: Empty Room: an empty interior drawn in soft black: tall windows, a round column, and a doorway opening to the outside

title: Blue Folds
description: A hanging cloth painted in the lightest blues and greys, with a few sharp creases catching the light. More suggestion than description, it is a study in restraint.
alt: Blue Folds: a hanging cloth painted in the lightest blues and greys, with a few sharp creases catching the light

title: Blue Sphere
description: A single sphere modelled in indigo washes, its highlight almost bare paper, casting a long shadow across a divided ground. A study of light in one color.
alt: Blue Sphere: a single sphere painted in indigo watercolor washes with a long cast shadow
